title: Bard - bookmarked audiobook player
subtitle: two SD storytellers navigated by a text-file mark list

pads.Play: play/pause; Alt = drop mark; hold = commit
pads.Reverse: jump back 15 s; Alt = re-roll auto-marks
pads.Seq: next segment; Alt = arm to clock, Alt-hold = loop/hold

ring: book progress + bookmark ticks; shelf dots (Alt)
crossfade: A/B blend of the two storytellers

switches.Routing (L/C/R): stereo image: a story per ear / mono / random
